definitions.gloss: memorial service; ceremony to console the spirits of the dead
definitions.explanation: A formal ceremony held to honor and comfort the spirits of deceased persons, often those who died in wars, disasters, or accidents.

examples.japanese: ⟦{毎年|まいとし}→毎年：00731_maitoshi⟧{慰霊祭|いれいさい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{行|おこな}われる→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: A memorial service is held every year.

examples.japanese: ⟦{戦没者|せんぼつしゃ}→戦没者：23238_senbotsusha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{慰霊祭|いれいさい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{参列|さんれつ}→参列：11888_sanretsu⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I attended a memorial service for those who died in the war.

examples.japanese: ⟦{震災|しんさい}→震災：14610_shinsai⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{十年|じゅうねん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{経|た}ち→経つ：09892_tatsu⟧、⟦{地元|じもと}→地元：09941_jimoto⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{慰霊祭|いれいさい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{開|ひら}かれた→開く：01979_hiraku⟧。
examples.english: Ten years after the earthquake disaster, a memorial service was held locally.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{慰霊|いれい}→慰霊：22918_irei⟧ (consoling the spirits of the dead) and {祭|さい} (ceremony/festival). These ceremonies are held for victims of wars, natural disasters, accidents, and other tragedies. They are distinct from personal funeral rites and typically serve a communal or public commemorative function.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {慰霊祭|いれいさい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧: to hold a memorial service

- ⟦{戦没者|せんぼつしゃ}→戦没者：23238_senbotsusha⟧{慰霊祭|いれいさい}: memorial for war dead
